records.text: Owens said correspondents claiming to work as electricians identified the similar shoes worn by security and Butch Hibbs as electrical-hazard footwear protecting against electrical currents; she shared the suggestion without claiming to know its context or significance.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It was that Butch Hibbs was wearing also an identical outfit with similar shoes. We had received a ton of emails from people that like work as electricians, which I thought was strange. ... I'm just raising this. I'm not saying anything other than it should be raised. But they say that these are shoes that are worn when there's a potential electrical hazard in labor trades and on job sites. ... Um, because they protect against electrical currents. They send links that these are, like, electrical hazard protection shoes. Now I will say, I do find it—now that I think about it, we're—they're wearing the same shoes. I don't know why you would need to have, like, light brown similar shoes. Again, sharing that, no context. But I guess the context is that they're all saying that those are shoes that are common for electrical hazards...
